system.effect:
This Interface's effect: Gain the Equipment Screen Reaction. It protects Composure or Harmony, not Fortitude.

Equipment Screen (EC05)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Resolve / Anima; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: 3 units / Self or one willing ally

Trigger: Another character declares an attack contesting Composure or Harmony against the target; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Choose the contested Defense: Composure uses Resolve, Harmony uses Anima. Increase that Defense by 1 for the target against the triggering attack. Roll only to generate Surges.

Surge 1: After the triggering attack resolves, the protected creature may move 1 unit. Once per use.

Design note: Can target yourself. Does not increase Fortitude or grant an extra Reaction.
